# Clarive: Listening Device for iPhone
> iOS app that turns an iPhone and any headphones into a real-time listening device: audio amplification and live captions in 40+ languages, processed 100% on-device.

## Key facts
- Platform: iOS 17+ (iPhone).
- Pricing: free to download. The free tier allows 5 uses per day. Paid plans are $5.99/month (3-day free trial) and $49.99/year (7-day free trial). Verified 2026-06-22; check the App Store listing for current pricing.
- Clarive is a sound amplification app, not a hearing aid or medical device. It does not diagnose or treat hearing loss.
- Works with ANY headphones. No AirPods or MFi hearing device required, unlike Apple's Live Listen.
- Live captions in 40+ languages, on-device, works offline after setup.
- Sound presets: Clear, Conversation, Noisy Place, TV & Media, Speech Clarity. Plus Voice Isolation and Focus Mode.
- Privacy: no audio leaves the device, no account required.
- Publisher: Harshva Technology Private Limited.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/listening-device-clarive/id6748903280
- Site: https://listeningdevice.app/
